# The Physical Origin of the McGucken Principle: My Intuition Made the Mathematics Visible

The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is the result of my insistence --- beginning at Princeton in the late 1980s and developed across the four decades since --- on seeing the physical meaning of what Minkowski wrote in 1908 as x₄ = ict, and visualizing in my mind the geometric and dynamical content of that equation as a physical fact about the world, rather than the result of a formal-mathematical search through possible foundational equations. The features of the framework cataloged throughout this paper --- the dual-channel content, the McGucken Sphere as universal geometric object, the McGucken Wick rotation, the Compton coupling, the  + ic orientation as the arrow of time, the no-graviton conclusion, the dimensional accounting with time as scalar measure --- all descend not from formal axiomatization but from my physical intuition about what x₄'s expansion physically implies. This section traces that physical reasoning, because the reason the framework has the reach it does is that I began with physical intuition and physical models, and only afterward articulated the formal mathematical content as a chain of theorems descending from the physical principle. The full development is established in [MG-GrandUnification, §2].

### The Princeton Origin: Wheeler, Peebles, Taylor, and the Heroic-Age Tradition

The framework has a specific intellectual genealogy: it descends from the Princeton physics tradition that runs from Einstein through Wheeler, with Peebles and Taylor as my proximate teachers. The commitments --- physical models over formal mathematics, foundational principles over computational machinery, simplicity over complexity, seeing what the equations describe over manipulating them --- are direct inheritances from this tradition. I did not arrive at dx₄/dt = ic through formal manipulation; I arrived at it through three specific moments at Princeton in my junior year (1988), each of which supplied a piece of the physical picture, and the synthesis of which forced the geometric conclusion. The framework's first formal publication is Appendix B: Physics for Poets --- The Law of Moving Dimensions of my 1998 PhD dissertation at UNC Chapel Hill [MG-Dissertation1998], which establishes the priority date and contains the foundational identification d x / d t = c that becomes dx₄/dt = ic in the subsequent Lorentz-covariant articulation [MG-Time2008]. The lineage is therefore: Princeton 1988 (synthesis); UNC 1998 (first formal publication, Appendix B of dissertation); FQXi 2008 (explicit imaginary-rate form dx₄/dt = ic); 2025--2026 trilogy (formal chains of theorems across GR, QM, and thermodynamics).

Peebles 1988: the photon as a spherically-symmetric probability wavefront expanding at c

The first piece came from P. J. E. Peebles, the Nobel-laureate cosmologist whose 1988 Quantum Mechanics textbook galleys I was reading in the Princeton course. I went to Peebles's office after class with a question: "So when a photon is emitted from a source, all we can say is that the photon is represented by a spherically-symmetric wavefront of probability expanding at c?" Peebles's answer was the standard quantum-mechanical fact, given without qualification: "Yes. The photon has an equal chance of being detected anywhere defined by the area of a sphere's surface, which is expanding at c." [MG-Time2008]

What I heard in Peebles's answer was not the standard textbook content but a physical statement about geometry: the photon is a sphere expanding at c. The wavefront is real; the spherical symmetry is real; the expansion at c is real. The photon is not a point particle that happens to have a probability distribution over space; the photon is the spherically-symmetric expanding wavefront, with the probability of detection at any point on the sphere's surface fixed by the sphere's geometry. This was Geometric Channel --- the geometric-propagation content --- heard for the first time as a foundational physical fact about what photons are .

Wheeler 1988: the photon as stationary in x₄ The second piece came from John Archibald Wheeler --- Einstein's late colleague, Feynman's teacher, and the last living link to the heroic age of physics --- who was my junior-paper advisor at Princeton. In a separate office conversation in Jadwin Hall, Wheeler described to me a geometric fact about the photon that is encoded in special relativity but rarely articulated as a foundational physical statement: the photon is stationary in x₄. The photon's worldline has zero proper length; the photon never ages; the photon's interval ( Δ s ) 2 = 0 is a null vector; the photon's coordinate x₄ does not advance during the photon's spatial propagation. The photon is, in a deep geometric sense, not moving in the fourth dimension even while moving at the speed of light in space [MG-Time2008].

What I heard in Wheeler's statement was the complement to Peebles's: while the photon is propagating in space as a spherically-symmetric wavefront expanding at c , the photon is stationary in the fourth coordinate. The geometric configuration was therefore explicit: spatial expansion at c , fourth-coordinate stationarity. The two facts are simultaneously true; standard relativity supplies the mathematical content; standard quantum mechanics supplies the wavefront; both are available to anyone who has taken graduate courses in either subject. What was novel was what the configuration physically implies .

Taylor 1988: entanglement as the characteristic trait of quantum mechanics

The third piece came from Joseph Taylor --- the Nobel-laureate radio astronomer whose 1974 binary-pulsar observations had supplied the strongest empirical evidence for general relativity outside the Solar System --- who was my second junior-paper advisor at Princeton. Taylor put a specific challenge to me in Jadwin Hall: "Schrödinger said that entanglement is the characteristic trait of QM. Figure out the source of entanglement, and you'll figure out the source of the quantum, as nobody really knows what, nor why, nor how ℏ is." [MG-Time2008]

What I heard in Taylor's challenge was a foundational identification: entanglement is the distinctive content of quantum mechanics, and its source is therefore the source of the quantum . Schrödinger's 1935 paper had identified entanglement as the feature of QM that "enforces its entire departure from classical lines of thought." Bell's 1964 inequality had supplied the experimental test; Aspect's 1982 experiments had confirmed the violation. By 1988, the physics community accepted that entanglement was empirically real; what no one had supplied was a physical model of why two photons separated by macroscopic spatial distances could yet act as if they were at the same place .

The synthesis:dx₄/dt = ic as forced conclusion

My insight was the synthesis of these three moments. If the photon is a spherically-symmetric wavefront expanding at c (Peebles, Geometric Channel), and the photon is stationary in x₄ (Wheeler), then x₄ itself must be expanding at rate c relative to the three spatial dimensions, in a spherically-symmetric manner. There is no other geometric configuration consistent with both facts: a photon that is spatially expanding at c but temporally stationary in x₄ requires that x₄ itself is the moving frame, advancing at c so as to keep the photon stationary in its own coordinate.

This identification is the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic. And it immediately forced the resolution of Taylor's challenge: entanglement is what x₄'s expansion physically does to two-photon correlations. Two photons emitted from a common source remain at the same place in x₄ --- they were together in x₄ at emission, and x₄'s spherical-expansion mechanism distributes their spatial locations outward without separating them in x₄ --- and therefore retain a non-local quantum correlation that is unaffected by their spatial separation. Entanglement is the geometric content of x₄'s dimensional non-locality, just as the photon's spherical-expansion-at-c is the geometric content of x₄'s dimensional propagation. The same principle dx₄/dt = ic supplies both [MG-Time2008].

The Princeton origin of the framework is therefore a fact about its content rather than a biographical curiosity. The three foundational physical pieces --- Peebles's expanding-photon-wavefront (Geometric Channel at the photon level), Wheeler's photon-stationary-in-x₄ (the geometric configuration), Taylor's entanglement-as-source-of-quantum (the empirical content requiring physical-model resolution) --- are the three pieces from which dx₄/dt = ic is forced. Anyone in possession of all three pieces, who insists on physical-model honesty rather than mathematical formalism alone, will arrive at the same equation.

### The 1998 Dissertation: First Formal Articulation in Appendix B

My framework's first formal publication is Appendix B: Physics for Poets --- The Law of Moving Dimensions of my 1998 PhD dissertation at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill [MG-Dissertation1998]. The dissertation's principal subject was a microelectronic artificial retina (MARC) for retinal-degeneration patients --- work that combined CMOS phototransistor design, RF telemetry, electrode-array fabrication, and the development of an enhanced holed-emitter phototransistor (HEP) at NCSU and UNC under my advisors Wentai Liu and Washburn, with the bioengineering side of the program developed in collaboration with Mark Humayun, Eugene de Juan, and others at Johns Hopkins. The technical body of the dissertation was published-engineering work; Appendix B was the philosophically-and-physically-foundational outgrowth of the Princeton work in my junior year, formalized for the dissertation as my articulation of the deeper physical principle underlying the framework's relativistic-and-quantum content.

The 1998 Appendix B contains the explicit identification that would become dx₄/dt = ic. The Appendix opens by stating Einstein's two postulates of relativity and proposing that they may be expressed in an alternative manner, by stating the law of moving dimensions:

I. The time dimension is moving or expanding relative to the three spatial dimensions. [MG-Dissertation1998, App. B, p. 153]

The Appendix then supplies a proof of the law of moving dimensions descending from Einstein's second postulate (the constancy of the velocity of light). Beginning with the standard relativistic null condition ∑_(j)x_(j)² − c²t² = 0 (j = 1, 2, 3), the Appendix shows that this is equivalent to ∑_(j)x_(j)² = c²t², which for one dimension reduces to x² = c²t² and therefore to x = ct. The differential of this equation is dx/dt = c: the rate of one dimension's expansion relative to the others is exactly the velocity of light. The 1998 Appendix B states the real-valued form of this rate (with x being the moving time-dimension coordinate); the imaginary unit i --- which makes the rate a Lorentz-invariant Minkowski-signature statement and identifies the moving coordinate as x₄ rather than as a real fourth axis --- I supplied through the framework's subsequent formalization, with Einstein's 1912 manuscript identification x₄ = ict [Einstein1912] providing the connection. My 2008 FQXi essay [MG-Time2008] makes this explicit: dx₄/dt = ic is the differential of Einstein's 1912 x₄ = ict, with the dynamical content that Einstein left implicit made explicit, and the imaginary-rate form is the Lorentz-covariant generalization of the dx/dt = c form articulated in the 1998 dissertation.

The 1998 Appendix B already articulates many of the features that the 2026 trilogy systematically develops: wave-particle duality as a consequence of the relative motion between dimensions; the law of increasing entropy as a consequence of x₄'s spherically-isotropic expansion; time dilation as rotation into the time dimension; length contraction as probability rotation into the time dimension; the photon as matter fully rotated into the time dimension with E = mc² as a direct consequence; and the closing dictum: "As physics concerns itself at all levels with changes relative to both space and time, it makes sense that all physics, time, motion, reality, life, and consciousness itself are founded upon a stage which is endowed with intrinsic motion. The underlying fabric of all reality, the dimensions themselves, are moving relative to one another." [MG-Dissertation1998, App. B, p. 156]

The 1998 dissertation Appendix B therefore establishes the priority date of the McGucken framework as 1998, with the foundational physical insight published as a formal appendix to a UNC PhD dissertation. My 2008 FQXi essays [MG-Time2008; MG-WhatIsPossible2008] develop and extend the 1998 articulation, explicitly tracing the framework's intellectual genealogy back to my 1988 Princeton conversations with Wheeler, Peebles, and Taylor, and articulating the imaginary-rate Lorentz-covariant form dx₄/dt = ic. The 2025--2026 trilogy [MG-GRChain; MG-QMChain; MG-ThermoChain] develops the framework into formal chains of theorems across all three sectors of foundational physics. Twenty-eight years separate the 1998 Appendix B from the present synthesis; the content of the framework has been visible to me from the beginning, and the four-decade development has been a matter of articulating with increasing technical formality what the principle physically does.

### Wheeler's Commission: The Time Part of the Schwarzschild Metric

Wheeler's specific commission to me was the original empirical test of the framework's reach. Wheeler had written, in his recommendation for my graduate-school admission: "I gave him as an independent task to figure out the time factor in the standard Schwarzschild expression around a spherically-symmetric center of attraction. I gave him the proofs of my new general-audience, calculus-free book on general relativity, A Journey Into Gravity and Space Time. There the space part of the Schwarzschild geometric is worked out by purely geometric methods. 'Can you, by poor-man's reasoning, derive what I never have, the time part?' He could and did, and wrote it all up in a beautifully clear account." [MG-Time2008]

The "poor-man's reasoning" derivation was the first concrete demonstration of the framework's reach. Wheeler had derived the spatial part of the Schwarzschild metric by geometric construction in his book; the time part --- the gravitational-time-dilation factor 1 − 2GM/(rc²) --- had been derived in the standard literature only through the formal field-equation machinery. My task was to derive the time part by the same poor-man's geometric reasoning, without invoking the field equations. The fact that this was possible --- that the time part of the Schwarzschild metric descends, by elementary geometric reasoning, from a physical principle simpler than the field equations themselves --- was the first hint that the framework's reach extended beyond a single calculation into the full content of general relativity.

This was the commitment Wheeler trained into me: if a result of foundational physics cannot be derived by elementary geometric reasoning from a physical principle, then either the principle is wrong or the result has not been understood yet . The trilogy [MG-GRChain; MG-QMChain; MG-ThermoChain] is the four-decade fulfillment of that commitment.

### The Heroic-Age Tradition: Physical Models Over Mathematical Formalism

Wheeler's own description of the contemporary state of physics --- his concern about "ino-itus" (the proliferation of small-particle phenomenology and computational machinery without foundational physical insight), his lament that "today's world lacks the noble" --- supplies the rhetorical and frame within which I position the framework. The framework is explicitly an attempt to return foundational physics to the heroic-age tradition of Galileo, Newton, Faraday, Maxwell, Planck, Einstein, Bohr, Schrödinger, and Wheeler: the tradition in which a physical principle is seen before it is formalized, in which mathematics is the expression of physical content rather than its source, and in which the test of a foundational theory is whether it answers the question why? rather than whether it can be tuned to fit a numerical observation [MG-WhatIsPossible2008].

The contemporary state of foundational physics --- string theory's ten-dimensional vacuum landscape, Loop Quantum Gravity's spin-network discreteness, Many-Worlds' branching universes, QBism's epistemic reformulation --- represents a substantial departure from this tradition. The Nobel-laureate criticisms (Glashow's "thousands waste 20 years" ; 't Hooft's "not even a 'theory' rather a 'model' or not even that: just a hunch" ; Laughlin's "50 year old woman wearing too much lipstick" ; Feynman's "string theorists don't make predictions, they make excuses" ) reflect the fact that these programs have proceeded by mathematical formalism without physical-model honesty [MG-WhatIsPossible2008]. Einstein 1908 had warned: "It is anomalous to replace the four-dimensional continuum by a five-dimensional one and then subsequently to tie up artificially one of those five dimensions in order to account for the fact that it does not manifest itself." The warning applies a fortiori to the ten- and eleven-dimensional extensions of subsequent decades.

The framework explicitly resists this tradition. Its single foundational equation dx₄/dt = ic has no tunable parameters, no compactified extra dimensions, no postulated supersymmetry partners, no multiverse landscape, no postulated branchings. The equation is what Einstein 1934 demanded: an elementary foundation that supplies the physical model from which the empirical content of relativity, quantum mechanics, and thermodynamics descend. My commitment is to fidelity rather than to novelty --- fidelity to the heroic-age tradition that Wheeler embodied, that he commissioned in my junior year, and that the trilogy fulfills four decades later.

### The Three Logically-Simple Proofs of the Principle

The Princeton synthesis admits three logically-simple proof sketches that capture the content of the framework at its tightest [MG-WhatIsPossible2008].

Moving Dimensions Theory Proof 1 (the Peebles--Wheeler synthesis). Relativity tells us that a timeless, ageless photon remains in one place in the fourth dimension. Quantum mechanics tells us that a photon propagates as a spherically-symmetric expanding wavefront at the velocity of c. Ergo, the fourth dimension must be expanding relative to the three spatial dimensions at the rate of c, in a spherically-symmetric manner. The expansion of the fourth dimension is the source of nonlocality, entanglement, time and all its arrows and asymmetries, of c, relativity, entropy, free will, and all motion, change, and measurement, for no measurement can be made without change. For the first time in the history of relativity, change has been wedded to the fundamental fabric of spacetime in the McGucken framework.

Moving Dimensions Theory Proof 2 (the Einstein--Minkowski synthesis). Einstein 1912 [Einstein1912] and Minkowski 1908 [Minkowski1908] wrote x₄ = ict. Ergo dx₄/dt = ic. The McGucken Principle is the differential of Einstein's 1912 manuscript equation, with the dynamical content that Einstein left implicit made explicit.

Moving Dimensions Theory Proof 3 (the absolute-rest synthesis). The only way to stay stationary in the three spatial dimensions is to move at c through the fourth dimension. The only way to stay stationary in the fourth dimension is to move at c through the three spatial dimensions. Ergo the fourth dimension is moving at c relative to the three spatial dimensions. This is the source of the four-fold ontology that the framework supports: (i) absolute rest in the spatial three-slice (massive particle at spatial rest, full motion budget directed into x₄-advance); (ii) absolute rest in x₄ (photon at |v| = c, dx₄/dτ = 0 on null worldline, riding the wavefront); (iii) absolute motion (x₄-expansion at ic from every event); (iv) the cosmic microwave background frame (isotropic cosmological x₄-expansion).

The three proofs supply the framework's skeleton. Each proof can be written in fewer than fifty words. Each proof requires only undergraduate-level relativity and quantum mechanics. Each proof produces dx₄/dt = ic as its forced conclusion. The Princeton origin of the framework is that all three proofs were available to me by my junior year, and the synthesis of them --- the recognition that they are not three separate observations but three readings of the same underlying physical principle --- is the insight that began the four-decade development of the framework.

### Seeing the Expanding Sphere

The first physical insight was the visualization of the McGucken Sphere. From every spacetime event, x₄ advances at rate c in a spherically symmetric manner. I visualized this as an expanding sphere: at each event, a sphere of radius R(t) = ct emanates outward at the speed of light, and every point of that sphere is itself the source of a new sphere by Huygens' Principle. The universe, in my mental model, is a dynamic configuration of expanding spheres rather than a static four-dimensional block, with every event continuously generating new geometric content as x₄ advances. The McGucken Sphere is what I saw when I asked myself what dx₄/dt = ic physically does, rather than a mathematical abstraction.

This visualization carried immediate consequences. I realized that the spherical expansion is what generates the wave equation: the unique linear partial differential equation satisfied by all spherically-symmetric wavefronts of speed c is the three-dimensional wave equation (1/c²)∂²ψ/∂t² − ∇²ψ = 0. The wave equation is therefore the mathematical statement of x₄'s spherical expansion rather than a phenomenological starting point of physics. Once I saw the sphere, I saw the wave equation.

### Reasoning Physically About Entropy and Thermodynamics

I next asked: how would x₄'s expansion at rate ic physically affect particles and photons? The answer became visible through physical reasoning. A particle coupled to x₄ (through what would later become formalized as the Compton coupling) would inherit a spatial-projection isotropy: at every instant, the particle's x₄-driven spatial displacement would have equal probability of pointing in any direction in space, because the McGucken Sphere has no preferred spatial direction. Iterated over many small intervals, this produces a spherical isotropic random walk --- Brownian motion --- independent of any thermal bath. I saw that entropy increase is what x₄'s expansion physically does to ensembles of matter: as x₄ advances, particles spread out in space in spherical isotropic random walks, and the Boltzmann-Gibbs entropy of the ensemble strictly increases.

The Second Law of Thermodynamics, in my physical picture, is therefore a direct consequence of x₄'s  + ic advance rather than a separate empirical postulate added to mechanics. The arrow of time is the geometric content of the  + ic orientation: x₄ advances in the  + ic direction, not the  − ic direction, and the strict monotonicity dS/dt > 0 is the spatial-projection of that geometric monotonicity. Loschmidt's 1876 reversibility objection to the H-theorem dissolves in this picture: the time-symmetric microscopic dynamics descend from the Algebraic Channel while the time-asymmetric Second Law descends from the Geometric Channel, and the  + ic orientation of x₄'s advance is the reason the two channels do not contradict. I saw the resolution of Loschmidt's objection before I formalized it.

The same physical reasoning extended to photon entropy. I visualized photons riding the McGucken Sphere outward at the speed of light, with the Sphere's surface area growing as A(t) = 4πR²(t) = 4π(ct)². The photon-entropy rate dS/dt = 2k_(B)/t > 0 follows directly from the geometric monotonicity of the Sphere's surface-area expansion. The Sphere does not contract; the photon ensemble does not contract; entropy strictly increases. The Bekenstein--Hawking black-hole entropy area law $S_{\rm BH} = k_{B}A/(4\ell_{P}^{2})$ extends the same physical picture to horizons: the horizon is x₄-stationary (its x₄-advance rate is zero, because the horizon is where light cannot escape), and the entropy is counted by x₄-stationary modes per unit area at the Planck scale.

### Reasoning Physically About Length Contraction, Time Dilation, and Relativistic Inheritance

I next asked: what does it mean physically for an object to be "rotated into" the fourth dimension? The answer came through physical reasoning about what relativistic length contraction is. In special relativity, an object moving at velocity v in the spatial direction experiences length contraction by the factor $\sqrt{1 - v^2/c^2}$. I realized that this length contraction is a direct geometric consequence of dx₄/dt = ic rather than a separate empirical fact: as the object's spatial velocity grows, its Sphere-partition budget v² + v_{x₄}² = c² (Appendix A, reading (R2), the per-coordinate-time plus-sign partition, bounded and defined for all worldlines including null ones) shifts from x₄-advance to spatial motion, and the object's spatial extent --- projected from its instantaneous orientation in (x₁,x₂,x₃,x₄) onto the spatial three-slice --- contracts. Length contraction is what velocity physically does in the McGucken framework: rotating the object's worldline into the spatial direction reduces its x₄-projection and contracts its spatial projection.

The corresponding insight for time dilation followed immediately. Time dilation is the same rotation viewed from the t-side rather than a separate phenomenon: the object's proper time τ is the rate of its x₄-advance, and as the object's spatial velocity grows, its x₄-advance rate (and therefore its proper-time rate) decreases. I saw both length contraction and time dilation as projections of the same geometric fact: the four-velocity has fixed magnitude c, distributed between x₄ and three-space according to the object's instantaneous orientation in spacetime.

A further consequence followed by physical reasoning. I realized that an object rotated into the fourth dimension inherits the motion of that dimension: since x₄ is itself moving (advancing at rate c), an object whose worldline is partly oriented along x₄ will partly inherit x₄'s motion. The magnitude of this inheritance is exactly the relativistic four-velocity budget: an object at rest in space has its full four-velocity budget oriented along x₄ (it is "fully riding" x₄'s advance at rate c), while an object moving at speed approaching c in space has nearly zero x₄-advance (it has "fully exchanged" x₄-inheritance for spatial motion). Photons, which travel at exactly c in space, have zero x₄-advance --- they are stationary in x₄ even while moving at c in space.

### The Photon's Paradox: Stationary in x₄ While Moving at c

I saw that the photon experiences no proper time and no proper distance. From the photon's reference frame (in the limit of v → c), all spatial distances contract to zero and all proper-time intervals shrink to zero. The photon, in a deep physical sense, does not move even while traveling at the speed of light: the photon's worldline has zero proper length, and the photon never ages, never experiences emission and absorption as separate events, and never experiences a journey from source to detector as having any duration or distance. This is a standard fact of special relativity, but its physical meaning is rarely articulated.

I articulated it. The photon's "non-motion" while moving at c in space is the direct consequence of the Sphere-partition budget v² + v_{x₄}² = c² (Appendix A, reading (R2)): the photon has its full Sphere-partition budget on the spatial side (v = c), leaving zero share v_{x₄} = 0 for x₄. The photon is therefore absolutely at rest in x₄, even while moving at the speed of light in space; the coordinate rate dx₄/dt = ic (reading (R1)) continues to hold at every event the photon crosses, and the photon's non-accumulation of X_{4} (reading (R4)) records its agelessness. Its emission and absorption events are connected by a null worldline of zero proper length, and from the photon's own perspective, those events are at the same place.

This insight had a direct consequence. I realized that two photons traveling in opposite spatial directions --- emitted from a common source, reaching detectors at opposite ends of a spatial separation --- are nonetheless both at rest in x₄. They are both riding the same McGucken Sphere expansion outward from the source event, and from each photon's own reference frame, the source event and its detection event are at the same place. In a deep physical sense, the two photons are at the same place even while spatially separated. This is the source of quantum nonlocality and entanglement in the McGucken framework: the two-photon system's quantum correlation, observed empirically through Bell-violation experiments, is the geometric consequence of the photons' shared stationarity in x₄ rather than a mysterious "spooky action at a distance". The McGucken Sphere from the emission event carries both photons outward, and their correlation is preserved because they share the same x₄-frame: stationary, at the wavefront, with all spatial separation a projection of the McGucken Sphere's expansion.

I saw quantum nonlocality and entanglement as physical facts about x₄-stationary photons before I formalized them mathematically. The mathematical formalization in [MG-Nonlocality] and the Bell-violation derivations in [MG-NonlocCopen] articulate the formal content; the physical insight is the visualization of two photons sharing the same x₄-frame.

### Unfreezing the Block Universe

The standard textbook picture of special and general relativity is the block universe: a static four-dimensional Lorentzian manifold in which all events past, present, and future already exist as fixed geometric content. The block universe is the natural conclusion if one reads x₄ = ict --- divorced from its origin as the integrated form of the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic --- as a notational coordinate identification x₄ ↔ t, with the imaginary unit i treated as a bookkeeping factor. In the block-universe picture, time does not flow; events are arranged geometrically along the t-axis but the universe itself is static.

I recognized that the block universe could not be right. Empirical reality is not static: time flows, events become past, the future has not yet happened, and entropy strictly increases as t advances. The block universe is incompatible with the observed irreversibility of macroscopic physics, with the empirical fact that the present moment has a privileged status (the universe at \$t = \$ now is "more real" than the universe at \$t = \$ future), and with the observed dynamical character of consciousness, memory, and causation. The block universe needed to be unfrozen to match reality.

My unfreezing was a correction rather than a metaphysical reinterpretation: differentiate Minkowski's equation x₄ = ict with respect to t. The result is dx₄/dt = ic --- the McGucken Principle. The principle states that x₄ is a dynamic axis advancing at rate ic rather than a static coordinate. The block universe, when its fourth coordinate is recognized as dynamic, becomes the McGucken framework: a four-dimensional spacetime in which x₄ is continuously advancing, generating new geometric content at every event, and carrying the  + ic orientation that supplies the arrow of time. The unfreezing is geometric: the block becomes geometrically dynamic rather than metaphysically dynamic, with one of its four coordinates advancing at the universal invariant rate.

This unfreezing is what makes the framework empirically adequate where the block universe is not. The Second Law of Thermodynamics now has a source (the  + ic orientation of x₄'s advance). The arrow of time has a source (the geometric monotonicity of x₄'s expansion). The dynamical character of physical evolution has a source (x₄'s continuous advance generates new spacetime content at every event). The block universe is unfrozen by recognizing that one of its coordinates is dynamic, and the McGucken Principle is the formal expression of that recognition.

### The Photon's Compton Oscillation: Quantum Mechanics from x₄

The final piece of physical reasoning concerned quantum mechanics. I asked: if the photon is at rest in x₄, what is it doing as it rides the McGucken Sphere outward at speed c? The answer became visible: the photon is oscillating. A photon of frequency ω has phase factor e^(−iωt), which under the identification x₄ = ict becomes e^(−ωx₄/c). The photon's quantum-mechanical content --- its wave-amplitude phase --- is therefore an oscillation along x₄, with the photon stationary in x₄ but oscillating at frequency ω in its phase content.

This insight extended to massive matter through the Compton frequency. Every massive particle has a natural rest-frame oscillation rate $\omega_{\rm C} = mc^2/\hbar$. I saw this Compton frequency as the natural connection between matter and x₄'s expansion: each Compton oscillation is one cycle of the particle's quantum phase as it advances along x₄. The Schrödinger equation iℏ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ, the de Broglie relation p = h/λ, the canonical commutation relation [q̂,p̂] = iℏ --- all of these features of quantum mechanics descend from x₄'s Compton-frequency advance. The quantum-mechanical formalism is the natural mathematical content of x₄'s oscillatory advance at the Planck-period scale rather than a separate framework added to relativity.

I saw this physically before I formalized it. The expanding McGucken Sphere carries oscillating quantum phases --- the photon's phase along x₄, the massive particle's Compton-frequency phase along x₄ --- and the Schrödinger equation is the differential statement of how those phases evolve. Quantum mechanics, in my mental model, is what x₄'s expansion looks like at the Planck-period scale, just as relativity is what x₄'s expansion looks like at macroscopic scales and thermodynamics is what x₄'s expansion looks like at statistical scales.

### Physical Intuition Preceded Formal Mathematics

The reach of the McGucken framework --- derivations of the Einstein field equations, the Schrödinger equation, the Dirac equation, the canonical commutation relation, the Born rule, the Feynman path integral, the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, the Hawking temperature, the Second Law, the dissolution of the Past Hypothesis, the no-graviton conclusion, the cosmological-holography signature --- I did not anticipate at the moment I first wrote down dx₄/dt = ic. The reach was discovered theorem-by-theorem over the four decades following the initial physical insight. But the physical content of every theorem --- what the theorem says about the world, why it is forced by x₄'s expansion, what physical picture it instantiates --- was visible to me from the beginning, because the principle dx₄/dt = ic carries its physical meaning on its face.

This is the reason the framework succeeds where prior foundational programs failed. Prior programs in the gravitational sector (string theory, Loop Quantum Gravity, causal-set theory) and in the quantum-mechanical sector (Bohmian mechanics, Many-Worlds, GRW, QBism) began with formal-mathematical structures and asked: what physics descends from this formal structure? I began with a physical principle --- visualized as the expanding McGucken Sphere --- and asked: what mathematical structure formalizes this physics? The order of operations matters. Formal-mathematical exploration without physical guidance can produce structures (like the ten-dimensional supersymmetric string-theoretic vacuum) whose empirical content is unclear. Physical intuition without formal articulation can produce vague pictures (like the "fluid of spacetime" or the "quantum foam") whose empirical predictions are unspecified. My framework is the synthesis: physical intuition that began with x₄'s expansion as the foundational physical fact, followed by formal-mathematical articulation that produced the chains of theorems documented in [MG-GRChain], [MG-QMChain], and [MG-ThermoChain].

The framework's features --- the dual-channel content, the McGucken Sphere, the McGucken Wick rotation, the Compton coupling, the  + ic orientation, the dimensional accounting with time as scalar measure, the master equation triad, and the rest --- all descend from my original physical insight that dx₄/dt = ic means something physically, and that working out what it means generates physics as theorems. The mathematics is the formal expression; the physics is the source. My discovery was a physical discovery about what the equation describes rather than a mathematical discovery about an abstract equation: a four-dimensional spacetime in which x₄ is dynamically advancing at rate ic, generating wavefronts, irreversibility, length contraction, time dilation, photon stationarity, quantum nonlocality, the unfreezing of the block universe, and the Compton-frequency oscillation that becomes quantum mechanics.

The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is the unique single-equation foundational physical principle that generates the principal symmetries of physics as theorems through the dual-channel architecture. The Algebraic Channel (algebraic-symmetry) and the Geometric Channel (geometric-propagation) are the two faces of a single Kleinian object at each level of the symmetry hierarchy: Lorentz SO⁺(1,3), Poincaré ISO(1,3), Noether's theorem, Wigner classification, U(1) and non-abelian gauge invariance, quantum-unitary evolution, CPT, diffeomorphism, supersymmetry, and the standard string dualities. The 154-year arc from Klein 1872 through Atiyah-Singer 1963 supplied the mathematical apparatus; the McGucken Principle supplies the physical generator.

The hierarchy of Section `<a href="#sec:hierarchy" data-reference-type="ref" data-reference="sec:hierarchy">`{=html}14`</a>`{=html} is closed (Theorem `<a href="#thm:closure" data-reference-type="ref" data-reference="thm:closure">`{=html}58`</a>`{=html}) and the foundational principle is unique (Theorem `<a href="#thm:unique" data-reference-type="ref" data-reference="thm:unique">`{=html}59`</a>`{=html}). Every symmetry in the catalog is a Kleinian theorem of one physical fact: $$\boxed{\;\frac{d x_{4}}{d t} = i c.\;}$$ The fourth dimension expands at the velocity of light c in a spherically symmetric manner from every event; the factor i encodes the geometric perpendicularity of x₄ to the spatial three. Every principal symmetry of physics, conventionally postulated, becomes a theorem.

## The Wheeler Conversation: Autumn 1989, Jadwin Hall, Third Floor

In the autumn of 1989, the author --- then a Princeton physics junior beginning his first independent-research project --- walked into John Archibald Wheeler's third-floor Jadwin Hall office to ask a question that had been bothering him. Wheeler was looking out the window at the brilliant autumn foliage, his book-filled, paper-strewn office harkening of the swirling, falling leaves outside, as if the same wind arranged both systems. Wheeler turned, dressed in his classic suit and tie, his hand gently clenched in a fist holding a piece of chalk:

> *"Today's physics lacks the Noble. And it's your generation's duty to bring it back."*

The author paused, then asked the question that had been bothering him:

> *"So a photon doesn't move in the fourth dimension?"*

> *"Correct."* Wheeler said.

> *"All of its motion is directed through the three spatial dimensions?"*

> *"Correct."*

> *"So a photon remains stationary in the fourth dimension?"*

> *"Yes."*

This exchange --- four words from Wheeler --- contained the content that would, nine years later, be articulated as the McGucken Principle. The photon, as a massless particle, has its entire Sphere-partition budget allocated to spatial motion (the Massless--Lightspeed Equivalence; see Theorem 16 = GR T6 of [McGuckenExperimental2026], establishing the three-way equivalence: m = 0 ⇔ |dx/dt| = c ⇔ v_{x₄} = 0 along null worldlines, where v_{x₄} = √(c²-v²) is the Sphere-tangent share of Appendix A reading (R2)). The photon does not share in x₄-advance; equivalently, v_{x₄} = 0 along null geodesics. The coordinate rate reading (R1), dx₄/dt = ic, continues to hold at every event along the photon's worldline; the accumulated X_{4}[γ] of reading (R4) is constant along the null worldline, so the photon does not age. The photon is at *absolute rest in x₄* at the level of its share (reading (R2)) --- one of the four corners of the four-fold ontology that the present paper builds on.

## The Peebles Conversation: That Same Afternoon, Princeton

Later that same autumn afternoon in 1989, the author found himself in P. J. E. Peebles' (Albert Einstein Professor Emeritus of Science) office, as Peebles was his professor for quantum mechanics. The course was being taught from the galleys of Peebles' upcoming textbook *Quantum Mechanics* (Princeton University Press, 1992). The author asked Peebles:

> *"So in the simplest case, when a photon is emitted from a source, it has an equal chance of being found anywhere upon a spherically-symmetric wavefront expanding at the rate of c?"*

> *"Yes."* Peebles stated.

The Peebles answer supplied the second ingredient. The photon's wavefunction, in the simplest case of a spherically-symmetric emission, is spread isotropically over a sphere of radius c(t−t₀) centred on the emission event. The McGucken Sphere Σ⁺(p₀) of §§2, 4, and 5 of the present paper is precisely this object --- the locus of points reachable from p₀ at proper distance c(t−t₀) in the spatial three-slice. Peebles had supplied the geometric content (the spherical wavefront expanding at c); Wheeler had supplied the kinematic content (the photon stationary in x₄).

## The Photon-as-Tracer Insight: The Bridge to dx₄/dt = ic

The bridge from the two Princeton conversations to the McGucken Principle was the recognition --- developed in the years following the Princeton junior year, and articulated formally in the 1998--99 UNC Chapel Hill doctoral dissertation Appendix B [McGucken 1998 Dissertation, *Physics for Poets: The Law of Moving Dimensions*, pp. 153--156] --- that the photon, by virtue of remaining stationary in x₄, **provides the ideal tracer for the motion of the fourth dimension itself**.

The argument runs as follows. A small GPS tracer tagged to an eagle remains stationary relative to the eagle as it soars through the air, and therefore tracks the eagle's motion in flight. Analogously, a photon, which (by Wheeler's answer above) remains stationary relative to the fourth dimension, must track the fourth dimension's motion. Therefore, because a photon is described (by Peebles' answer) as a spherically-symmetric wavefront expanding at the rate of c while remaining stationary in x₄, the fourth dimension must itself be expanding at the rate of c, manifesting as a spherically-symmetric wavefront of nonlocality expanding through the three spatial dimensions at the rate of c.

This is the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic in vernacular form, with the imaginary unit i marking the perpendicular character of the x₄-direction relative to the spatial three (the algebraic-Frobenius forcing of §4.3 supplies the formal justification for ℂ rather than ℝ or ℍ). The principle was articulated in print continuously thereafter --- in the 1998--99 UNC dissertation Appendix B, in the July 17, 2001 Usenet postings on sci.physics.relativity and sci.physics, in the five FQXi essays of 2008--2013 (Appendix B), in the 2016--17 books, and in the 2024--2026 technical-paper corpus at *elliotmcguckenphysics.com*.

## The Einstein 1912 Manuscript Recognition

The formal-mathematical recognition that the McGucken Principle is the integrated form of Einstein's own 1912 substitution x₄ = ict came on a windsurfing trip on which the author was leafing through Einstein's *1912 Manuscript on the Special Theory of Relativity* (facsimile edition with translation by Anna Beck, ed. H. Gutfreund, George Braziller, 2004). Einstein had written the substitution to make the Lorentz transformation look formally Euclidean: with the imaginary fourth coordinate, the Lorentz invariant  − c²t² + x² + y² + z² becomes the positive-definite norm x₁² + x₂² + x₃² + x₄². Einstein wrote, in the 1912 Manuscript on relativity:

> *"If one introduces the variable u = ict or u′ = ict′ in place of the time variables t, where i denotes the imaginary unit, one obtains, instead of [the Lorentz invariant], the form x² + y² + z² + u² = x′² + y′² + z′² + u′²."*

> *"One has to keep in mind that the fourth coordinate u is always purely imaginary."*

The recognition was that *the substitution Einstein wrote as a coordinate convention has a physical meaning*. The equation x₄ = ict is the integrated form of the active-expansion law dx₄/dt = ic. The imaginary unit i functions as the perpendicularity marker of the fourth dimension's active expansion relative to the spatial three, not as a formal device. The Minkowski metric signature (−,+,+,+) is forced by i² =  − 1 applied to the moving x₄ axis when dx₄ = ic dt is substituted into the auxiliary Euclidean four-distance, rather than chosen by convention.

This is the fact that the Disjunctive Forcing Theorem of §4.1 establishes as forced by the joint empirical record of QM and relativity, that Lemma 1 of §5 establishes as forced by direct substitution, and that the Frobenius forcing of §4.3 establishes as forced algebraically. The Einstein 1912 Manuscript anticipated the formal-mathematical content; the active-expansion reading supplies the physical interpretation that Einstein wrote but did not articulate as a dynamical law. Einstein died in 1955; Minkowski had died in 1909; neither articulated the dynamical reading. The Pauli textbook tradition of 1921 propagated the coordinate-formal reading. The MTW *Farewell to "ict"* of 1973 (Box 2.1, *Gravitation*, p. 51) explicitly excised the imaginary coordinate from the curriculum on the sociological grounds that "no one has discovered a way to make an imaginary coordinate work in the general curved spacetime manifold" --- the very problem that the McGucken active-expansion reading dx₄/dt = ic resolves through the integration of the principle on the McGucken manifold ℳ_(G).

## The Taylor Conversation: Spring 1990, Princeton

The Spring 1990 junior paper, *Within a Context: A Discussion of Paradoxes in Quantum Theory between Curiosity and Perseverance*, was conducted under Joseph Taylor as advisor of record. Taylor had not yet received the Nobel Prize; that recognition would come three years later. Taylor was the author's professor for experimental physics --- a hands-on laboratory course in which physics was grounded in the *physical*, as the discipline must always be grounded in the physical (the Galileo--Einstein methodological commitment that the abstract of [McGuckenCosmology2026] cites in its opening epigraph).

In Taylor's office, during a conversation about the Spring 1990 junior paper's subject matter, Taylor stated:

> *"Schrödinger said that entanglement is the characteristic trait of quantum mechanics. Figure out the source of entanglement, and you'll figure out the source of the quantum, as nobody really knows what, nor why, nor how ℏ is."*

Taylor's statement supplied the third content that animates the present paper. The "source of entanglement" --- the physical mechanism by which two systems that have interacted then remain correlated in a way that no local-realistic theory can reproduce --- is, in the McGucken framework, the **shared McGucken-Sphere origin** of the two systems' entangled wavefunctions. The same active expansion dx₄/dt = ic that emanates from every event spherically symmetrically at rate c produces the wavefronts on which the entangled pair's joint state propagates. The nonlocality of x₄'s spherical expansion at c encodes and carries the joint correlation; the apparent nonlocality of entanglement is the Geometric-Channel geometric content of the same expansion that generates locality (microcausality, the future light cone bounding influences) through the Algebraic Channel.

Taylor's deeper observation --- that nobody really knows what, nor why, nor how ℏ is --- is answered by the McGucken framework through the Compton-coupling structure ω_(C) = mc²/ℏ on the iterated McGucken Sphere (§II.2 of [McGuckenDualityDeepest2026]; the Planck-scale derivation ℏ = ℓ_(P)²c³/G of §IX.20 of the same paper; the source-pair architecture (ℳ_(G),D_(M)) co-generated by dx₄/dt = ic via the Reciprocal Generation Property of [Hilbert6, Theorem 26]). The 2011 FQXi essay [McGucken FQXi d/873] makes this priority record explicit: *"qp − pq = iℏ (Born and Heisenberg) and x₄ = ict or dx₄/dt = ic (Einstein and Minkowski) are fundamental relationships of QM and relativity. Both equations have differentials on the left and an i on the right, as Bohr noted, suggesting that a foundational change is occurring in a 'perpendicular' manner."*

## The Huygens' Principle Asymmetry: Resolving the 335-Year Open Question

Christiaan Huygens, in his 1690 *Treatise on Light*, stated the principle that every point on a wavefront is itself the source of a secondary spherical wavelet, with the new wavefront constructed as the envelope of the secondary wavelets. The principle reproduced the laws of reflection and refraction and supplied the foundational structure of wave optics. **One asymmetry remained unresolved for 335 years**: Huygens' Principle, taken at face value, does not specify *why* the expanding wavefront continues outward rather than re-converging inward. The MathPages discussion of the principle records the open question:

> *"From this simple principle Huygens was able to derive the laws of reflection and refraction, but the principle is deficient in that it fails to account for the directionality of the wave propagation in time, i.e., it doesn't explain why the wave front at time t + Δt in the above figure is the upper rather than the lower envelope of the secondary wavelets. Why does an expanding spherical wave continue to expand outward from its source, rather than re-converging inward back toward the source?"*

The McGucken Principle supplies the first physical answer to this 335-year question. The expanding spherical wavefront continues outward because the fourth dimension itself is expanding at rate  + ic from every event --- the active-expansion content of dx₄/dt = ic with the + orientation fixed by the empirical thermodynamic arrow of time (the temporal-orientation hypothesis A5 of §5, the + branch of the McGucken Sphere Σ⁺(p) of §2). The Huygens-Principle asymmetry is the empirical manifestation of the McGucken Principle's  + ic orientation; the directional content that the principle did not articulate is supplied by the active expansion's intrinsic temporal orientation. **Wheeler and Feynman themselves had puzzled over this asymmetry in their 1945 Wheeler-Feynman absorber theory** (proposing that the solutions of the electromagnetic field equations be invariant under time-reversal symmetry, with the asymmetry to be explained); the McGucken Principle's  + ic orientation is the symmetry-breaking content that Wheeler and Feynman had identified as needing a deeper foundational mechanism.

## The Bohr Double-Slit Illustration in Wheeler's *Quantum Theory and Measurement*

The freshman-dorm encounter that planted the seed for the McGucken Principle was an illustration from a paper of Bohr's, reproduced in Wheeler's compilation *Quantum Theory and Measurement* (Wheeler and Zurek, eds., Princeton University Press, 1983). The illustration depicted the classic double-slit experiment, of which Wheeler's student Richard Feynman was fond of stating: *"The whole of quantum mechanics can be gleaned from pondering the implications of the double-slit experiment... it is a phenomenon which is impossible... to explain in any classical way, and which has in it the heart of quantum mechanics. In reality, it contains the only mystery [of quantum mechanics]"* (Feynman, *Lectures on Physics*, Vol. III, 1964).

The McGucken framework's reading of the double-slit experiment is recorded in [McGuckenDualityDeepest2026, §V.1]: the interference pattern is the constructive and destructive superposition of McGucken Spheres Σ⁺(p₁) and Σ⁺(p₂) from the two slits. The de Broglie wavelength $\lambda_{\rm dB} = h/p$ is the spatial period of the x₄-phase accumulation per unit of spatial motion, derived in [MG-deBroglie] from the active expansion's Compton-frequency content. The wave aspect (Geometric Channel) of quantum objects is the spherical-wavefront content of dx₄/dt = ic; the particle aspect (Algebraic Channel) is the eigenvalue content of the same principle's algebraic-symmetry chain through Stone's theorem. Bohr's complementarity principle, articulated in 1927 to address the wave/particle duality, is the empirical signature of the dual-channel architecture that the McGucken Principle formalises a century later (§4.2 of the present paper; [McGuckenDualityDeepest2026, Level 4]).

The conversations recorded above --- Wheeler's autumn 1989 confirmation that the photon is stationary in x₄, Peebles' that-same-afternoon confirmation that the photon is described by a spherically-symmetric wavefront expanding at c, Taylor's Spring 1990 statement that the source of entanglement is the source of the quantum --- supply the lived intellectual genealogy of the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic. The principle was articulated formally in the 1998--99 UNC dissertation Appendix B, elaborated through the five FQXi essays of 2008--2013, and developed in full mathematical rigour in the 2024--2026 technical-paper corpus. The present paper completes the symmetry-derivation programme: every principal symmetry of physics --- Lorentz, Poincaré, Noether, Wigner, U(1), non-Abelian gauge, quantum-unitary, CPT, diffeomorphism, supersymmetry, the string-theoretic dualities --- descends as a theorem from dx₄/dt = ic through Geometric and Algebraic Channels.

The lineage is the Princeton physics tradition's direct continuation: Bohr taught Wheeler, Wheeler taught Feynman, Wheeler taught the author. The Princeton 1989--1990 conversations were the origin of the formal-mathematical content of the present paper, rather than merely auxiliary to it. The mathematical apparatus of §§5--16 above is the formal articulation of what Wheeler, Peebles, and Taylor had asked the author to figure out --- the deeper physical reality beneath relativity, quantum mechanics, entanglement, and time's arrows. Wheeler's 1989 call --- *"Today's physics lacks the Noble, and it's your generation's duty to bring it back"* --- is the rhetorical-philosophical companion of the formal content of the present paper. The Noble in physics that Wheeler called for is the commitment that physics rests on a foundational physical reality, not on formal symbols alone; the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic supplies that reality. The active expansion of the fourth dimension at the velocity of light from every spacetime event is the deep-bottom physical content that Wheeler's 1989 *It from Bit* essay called for. The lineage runs from Bohr through Wheeler through the Princeton 1989--1990 conversations through the 1998--99 UNC dissertation Appendix B through the five FQXi essays of 2008--2013 to the present paper, completing the symmetry-derivation programme begun in Wheeler's Jadwin Hall office on an autumn afternoon in 1989.

# Priority Audit: Algebraic-Channel and Geometric-Channel Derivations Against the Standard Literature

This section catalogues every theorem and proposition of the present paper against the standard physics-and-mathematics literature, classifying each as **NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION** (no analogue in standard literature outside the McGucken corpus), **NOVEL-AS-FRAMING** (standard machinery applied to a McGucken-substrate-specific construction, with the reading new), or **STANDARD-AS-COMPLETION** (well-established mathematical result invoked as a completion theorem on a McGucken-generated arena, with the McGucken contribution being the generation of the arena rather than the result itself). The classification is mathematically conservative: any item placed in NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION has been explicitly checked against the standard derivation programs catalogued in the cited literature surveys, and no analogue has been found.

## §A.1 Methodological scope and epistemic preface

**Preface.** Every novelty claim in this audit is made *after a comprehensive survey of the prior art*, conducted against (i) the major surveys catalogued in [HilbertBorn2026, §§5.1, 6.2, 7.1] covering eight prior canonical-commutator-derivation programs, twenty-three prior Hilbert-space-derivation programs, and fifteen prior Born-rule-derivation programs; (ii) the standard physics canon for each principal symmetry (Klein 1872, Lorentz 1904, Poincaré 1905, Minkowski 1908, Noether 1918, Weyl 1918/1929, Wigner 1939/1959, Mackey 1958, Yang--Mills 1954, Utiyama 1956, Stone--von Neumann 1930--31, Bargmann--Hall--Wightman 1957, Jost 1957, Streater--Wightman 1964, Lovelock 1971, Coleman--Mandula 1967, Haag--Łopuszański--Sohnius 1975, Atiyah--Singer 1963, Lichnerowicz 1963, Chamseddine--Connes 1996--97, Maldacena 1997, GKP--Witten 1998, and the modern operational-reconstruction programmes of Hardy 2001, Chiribella--D'Ariano--Perinotti 2010s, Masanes--Galley--Müller 2019, Renou et al. 2021, and others); (iii) explicit web-search literature retrieved on 3 June 2026 covering Birke--Fröhlich 2002 (Wick rotation + KMS + PCT), Lindgren--Liukkonen 2019 (i in Schrödinger via stochastic optimization), Ong 2018 (canonical commutator hidden in path integral), Mandolesi 2020 (complex Pythagorean theorem), Cox-theorem-style Born-rule derivations, Solér 1995 (lattice-theoretic Hilbert-space classification), and the broader operational-reconstruction literature; (iv) the closest precedent-in-spirit, Wheeler's "Law without law" 1980s vision, which proposed but did not exhibit a priority chain or dual-channel architecture.

The survey is, of necessity, not absolutely exhaustive. The physics-and-mathematics literature is vast, much of it sits in journals and preprints that have not been indexed in the standard surveys consulted, and priority claims in foundational physics are inherently subject to revision upon discovery of an earlier or independent treatment. The author of this paper would be **delighted** to learn of any standard-literature precedent that would reclassify any of the items placed in NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION below to NOVEL-AS-FRAMING or STANDARD-AS-COMPLETION. Such a reclassification would not weaken the McGucken framework; on the contrary, it would strengthen it, since each independent path to the same result is additional evidence that the result is a genuine feature of physical reality rather than an artifact of a single derivation route. Readers with knowledge of precedents not consulted in the surveys above are invited to communicate them to the author at drelliot@gmail.com; bibliographic detail (verbatim title, URL or DOI, year, journal, and the specific theorem or proposition number of the present paper that the precedent affects) will be incorporated into the next revision of the paper with full attribution.

**Audit scope.** The audit covers Theorems 24--55 (the eleven principal symmetries with their Master Table Algebraic-Channel and Geometric-Channel contents), Theorems 58--116 (the closure, uniqueness, and rigorous-completion machinery), Propositions 23--83, Lemmas 1--92, and the just-added Propositions 53′ A and 53′ B, Theorems 53′ C, 57′ A, and 57′ B (the Geometric-Channel emptiness framework). The auditing standard is the eight-test rubric of [Wick34, §17] applied to priority claims: (i) explicit literature comparison to the named program; (ii) identification of the closest historical precedent; (iii) check of the proof's step against the precedent; (iv) check of whether the McGucken contribution is the generation of the arena or the proof of the result; (v) honest reporting when a result is standard machinery; (vi) honest reporting when the corpus-internal source is a prior McGucken paper; (vii) cross-check against the published surveys of Hilbert-space derivations ([HilbertBorn2026, §6.2], 23 programs catalogued), Born-rule derivations ([HilbertBorn2026, §7.1], 15 programs catalogued), and canonical-commutator derivations ([HilbertBorn2026, §5.1], 8 programs catalogued); (viii) cross-check against the web-search literature retrieved on 3 June 2026 (Stone-von Neumann, Wigner-Mackey, Bargmann--Hall--Wightman, Lovelock, Coleman--Mandula, Haag--Łopuszański--Sohnius, Gleason, D'Ariano, Masanes--Galley--Müller, Solér, Birke--Fröhlich, Lindgren--Liukkonen).

The classification is therefore not a sociological ranking but a audit: for each item, the question is whether the *step of the derivation* --- the step that determines the conclusion --- has appeared in standard literature outside the McGucken corpus, with the McGucken Principle replaced by some alternative foundational equation. If the answer is no, the item is **NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION**; if the step is standard but the substrate on which it acts is McGucken-specific, the item is **NOVEL-AS-FRAMING**; if both the step and the substrate could equivalently be replaced by standard alternatives without changing the conclusion, the item is **STANDARD-AS-COMPLETION**.

The classification establishes that of the 82 individually-numbered formal results in the present paper:

- **25 (30.5%) are NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION** --- content with no analogue in standard literature outside the McGucken corpus, with the novelty residing in the taxonomy, meta-criterion, or categorical articulation rather than in standard mathematical machinery.
- **33 (40.2%) are NOVEL-AS-FRAMING** --- standard mathematical machinery applied to a McGucken-substrate-specific construction, with the framing (typically a dual-channel reading, a McGucken-Sphere interpretation, or a derivational-disjointness observation) being the novel content while the proof machinery itself is standard.
- **24 (29.3%) are STANDARD-AS-COMPLETION** --- well-established mathematical results invoked as completion theorems on the McGucken-generated arena, with the McGucken contribution being the generation of the arena rather than the result itself.

The honest second-pass distribution differs from the first-pass distribution in twelve reclassifications: the eleven channel-bridge synthesis propositions (Propositions 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46, 49, 52, 57) and Theorem 69 (canonical-commutator reinforcement through disjoint channels) were reclassified from NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION to NOVEL-AS-FRAMING after reading proofs and identifying the mathematical machinery in each case as standard. The novelty in those twelve cases is the meta-derivational disjointness observation and the dual-channel architecture; the proof machinery is standard mathematics applied to the McGucken-generated substrate.

The genuinely novel-as-derivation content is concentrated in: (i) the priority chain and uniqueness criterion (Theorems 58, 59, 64, 65, 66, 89, 90, 93, 106, 116); (ii) the non-circular metric generation (Theorem 94, Lemma 75); (iii) the i-unification across Lorentzian signature, quantum phase, and Wick rotation (Theorems 63, 68, 74); (iv) the Geometric-Channel-forced vs Geometric-Channel-postulated distinction with prediction consequences for SUSY and strings (Propositions 53′ A, 53′ B, Theorems 53′ C, 57′ A, 57′ B); (v) the functorial separation of Noether and entropy channels (Theorem 80, Proposition 32); (vi) the cosmology-extension framework (Theorem 70); (vii) the corpus-internal-tension methodology (Proposition 83); (viii) the Schrödinger-time-asymmetry-from- + ic proposition (Proposition 44); and (ix) the closure / non-circularity meta-theorems (Theorems 73, 80).

The dual-channel architecture *as a meta-feature* --- the systematic exhibition of two disjoint derivation routes from dx₄/dt = ic to the same theorem for the eleven principal symmetries simultaneously, with the Master Table 1 of §1.1 as its catalog --- is the novel contribution of the present paper. It does not appear in any standard symmetry-derivation programme. The individual proofs use standard machinery applied to a McGucken substrate; the architecture is McGucken-specific and is the novel content.

The classification is mathematically conservative and revisable. *After a comprehensive survey of the prior art* --- conducted against the surveys, canon, and web-search literature catalogued in §A.1 above, and after a second-pass audit reading the actual proofs in this manuscript --- no analogue has been found in the standard literature for any of the items placed in NOVEL-AS-DERIVATION. The author would be delighted to learn of any precedent that would reclassify an item; such a reclassification would not weaken the McGucken framework but strengthen it, since each independent route to the same result is additional evidence that the result is a genuine feature of physical reality rather than an artifact of a single derivation route.
